documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Silkflex Polymers (India) Limited has transitioned from a trading-led model to a manufacturing-driven company with the commencement of full-scale commercial production at its Vadodara facility. The plant has an installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and currently operates at approximately 60% capacity utilization. Management expects to reach full capacity utilization by the end of FY27 and aims to increase manufacturing's contribution to 50% of the revenue mix. The company also plans to reduce its debt completely using internal accruals. Silkflex Polymers published its Q4 and FY26 investor presentation detailing its operational transition from trading to manufacturing, highlighted by the commissioning of a new automated plant in Vadodara.

guidance.claim: The company expects to reach full capacity utilization by the end of financial year '27.
guidance.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

guidance.claim: The company aims to scale manufacturing utilization and increase manufacturing's contribution to 50% of the revenue mix in FY2027.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead to FY2027, our priorities remain clear: scaling manufacturing utilization, increasing the contribution of manufacturing towards 50% of our revenue mix, expanding binder sales into non-textile industries as well and deepening our engagement with global brands.

guidance.claim: The company expects overall EBITDA to increase by 200 to 300 basis points.
guidance.quote: So overall EBITDA can increase by 200-300 basis points. If seen overall, we can expect expansion by 2% to 3%.

guidance.claim: The company expects the wood-coating segment's current contribution of 6% to double.
guidance.quote: Plus, our distribution of business for wood-coating, the current contribution of 6%, the growth of that can also double.

guidance.claim: The company expects 10% to 20% growth in the trading business for the year.
guidance.quote: 10%-20% growth, but the focus will continue to be on manufacturing for this year.

guidance.claim: Management expects 15% to 20% growth in the textile ink market and 20% to 30% growth in the wood coating market.
guidance.quote: Rohan, now both the segments are growing exceptionally and I am looking for 15% to 20% in the ink market in the textile market, I mean to say. And for the wood coating market it will be more like 20% to 30% in wood coating.

guidance.claim: Management hopes to achieve full plant capacity by the next financial year.
guidance.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

guidance.claim: Management expects manufacturing and trading to each account for 50% of the business within 1 to 2 years.
guidance.quote: Like 50% import and 50% products we may be manufacturing like that within 1 and 2 years.

demand_outlook.claim: The near-term export environment remains somewhat cautious due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.
demand_outlook.quote: From a demand standpoint, the near-term export environment remains somewhat cautioned due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: There is a lot of awareness to get out of solvents in the market.
demand_outlook.quote: Because now, there is a lot of awareness to get out of solvents in the market.

demand_outlook.claim: The company reported being encouraged by improving demand trends in the wood coating segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Encouraged by improving demand trends, we expect to selectively expand our market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Textile manufacturers shifting towards eco-friendly inks positions Silkflex to benefit through its water-based ink systems.
demand_outlook.quote: Firstly, as textile manufacturers scale and upgrade their processing, shifting towards premium durable eco-friendly inks, we are already positioned to benefit from our advanced water-based ink system which delivers superior durability and garment integrity.

demand_outlook.claim: Recent trade deals with the EU and US create significant export opportunities for Indian textile and furniture manufacturers.
demand_outlook.quote: Thirdly, the recent India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal opens a significant growth opportunities for Indian textile exports as well as furniture exports by eliminating duties on most of the products, narrowing the competitive gap with countries like Bangladesh and Pakistan.

demand_outlook.claim: Growing demand for sustainable wood coatings makes water-based polymer products increasingly essential.
demand_outlook.quote: Secondly, in the coating segment, the growing demand for sustainable wood coating across furniture, interior, and decorative applications make our premium water-based polymer range increasing essentially.

demand_outlook.claim: Global apparel brands are increasing procurement from India due to the China Plus One strategy and operational challenges in Bangladesh.
demand_outlook.quote: The China Plus One strategy has gained momentum and with Bangladesh facing challenges such as power disruptions, political unrest, rising production cost, and stricter compliances requirements, India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through internal resources.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has further scope to expand manufacturing capacity by putting up vessels costing about INR 3 crores to INR 5 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We have furthermore scope of putting up the vessels, which will be costing near about INR3 crore, INR4 crore, INR5 crores, and we can expand our manufacturing capacity as well according to the requirements.

capex_expansion.claim: The company opened a branch at Kochi three months ago.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, 3 months before, we have been opened a branch at Kochi which is a very good manufacturing hub for the furniture.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has completed its full capex and does not expect expansion right now.
capex_expansion.quote: So, we have done full capex and we aren't expecting expansion right now.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara.
capex_expansion.quote: Commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, marking the company’s strategic shift from trading to a manufacturing-led model to enhance margins, scalability, and operational control.

capex_expansion.claim: Silkflex commenced commercial production at its first automated manufacturing plant in Vadodara, Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: I am pleased to share that this quarter marks a significant milestone for Silkflex Polymers India Limited with the commencement of commercial production at our first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.

capex_expansion.claim: The company established a new office in Kochi to serve domestic wood coating products during the quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: And in this quarter, we added the Kochi office for domestic wood coating products.

capex_expansion.claim: Management has planned expansion within the next six months to manufacture binders or inks domestically based on partner discussions.
capex_expansion.quote: We have planned our expansion within the next 6 months because we will also make domestic binders or based on our discussions, we can also make ink in the coming time.

capex_expansion.claim: The company does not require high capex currently as utility and storage infrastructure are already installed.
capex_expansion.quote: No, Rohan as I already told reply in the previous questions also that our plant has been designed in such a manner that we don't need any high capex for as of now.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: With this backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%, reduce our import dependency and enhance supply reliability.

margins_costs.claim: Input costs have remained volatile, with raw materials seeing a sharp increase during the year.
margins_costs.quote: On the supply side, input costs have remained volatile. To put this in perspective, raw materials saw a sharp increase during the year, largely driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the manufacturing segment are around 20% to 25%, compared to 12% to 15% for the trading business.
margins_costs.quote: When we compare specifically for, comparison with manufacturing and trading business, we can see that the EBITDA margins are around 20%-25% for the manufacturing segment, and for our trading business it is 12% to 15%.

margins_costs.claim: The company expects better fixed cost absorption to lead to gross margin expansion over time.
margins_costs.quote: So when over time, which is our estimation, that by the end of financial year '27 we will do 100%, then by that time we are expecting that the fixed cost absorption will also be better, and as soon as that is better you will see expansion in gross margin.

margins_costs.claim: The company transitioned from a trading-led to a manufacturing-led model to strengthen margins, quality control, and supply chain visibility.
margins_costs.quote: Transitioned from a trading-led to a manufacturing-led model, strengthening margins, quality control, and supply chain visibility

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit margin for Q4 FY26 was reported at 33.2%.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Profit Margin (%) 33.2% 39.0% -580 bps 25.0% 820 bps 28.2% 25.8% 240 bps

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q4 FY26 was reported at 23.1%.
PAT margin for Q4 FY26 was reported at 11.9%.
EBITDA margin expanded by 1,150 basis points year-on-year to 21.2% in Q3 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points to 21.2% from 9.7% in the quarter 3 from the financial year '25.

margins_costs.claim: Manufacturing margins are currently around 25% and expected to approach 50% as production ramps up.
margins_costs.quote: Currently our margin in manufacturing is around 25%. And in the coming time, we can expect margins to be near about 50% according to the production.

margins_costs.claim: Starting local manufacturing reduced import reliance by 10% to 12%.
margins_costs.quote: But still, even though manufacturing has started for these two products, our reliance on imports has reduced by about 10% to 12%.

orders_capacity.claim: The Vadodara plant has an installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: The Facility is spread over 10 acres of land with 72,000 square feet automated setup and the plant has been installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and operates on a boiler-less, zero-carbon and zero-discharge model, aligned with our sustainability which is the first philosophy.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization stood at approximately 60% in the first year of operations.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization stood at present approximately 60% in the first year of operations and scaling this remains a key priority for FY2027.

orders_capacity.claim: The company is currently utilizing only 20% of the space after installing the 500-ton capacity system.
orders_capacity.quote: See, after achieving the optimum utilization, the capex what we have been used is almost already ready for that, and out of that we are right now utilizing only 20% space after installing the system of the 500-ton capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The company offers a diverse portfolio of 128 textile printing inks and 70 wood coating polymer products.
orders_capacity.quote: Silkflex offers a diverse portfolio of 128 textile printing inks and 70 wood coating polymer products.

orders_capacity.claim: The Vadodara automated manufacturing facility has an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

orders_capacity.claim: The manufacturing facility operated at approximately 60% capacity during November and December.
orders_capacity.quote: In first 2 months, that is November and December, after starting the manufacturing, we utilized around 60% capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: Full capacity utilization at 500 tons per month can generate around INR 70 crores to INR 80 crores in turnover.
orders_capacity.quote: It will come to around INR70 crores to INR80 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: In Q3 FY26, manufacturing accounted for 25% of total revenue while trading generated 75%.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes, out of this INR33 crores revenue in Q3, from the manufacturing we are getting 25% and rest of the 75% from the trading business.

capital_allocation.claim: The company does not expect working capital to become a constraint due to internal availability and good cash flow.
capital_allocation.quote: So, Nidhi ji, basically we aren't expecting that working capital as such should become any constraint in our growth, mostly because internal availability is there, and more than that our cash flow is very good.

capital_allocation.claim: The company does not currently plan to increase debt unless it takes on additional capex.
capital_allocation.quote: So, basically, not really until and unless, we are taking on additional capex in which case, yes, we'll need additional working capital, and thereby, yes there will be increase in debt for the next year, but currently we don't have any plans as such.

capital_allocation.claim: Silkflex has a bank term loan of INR 30 crores and working capital borrowings of INR 20 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our term loan is INR30 crores and working capital is INR20 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The expected payback period for the manufacturing plant investment is between 4 and 5 years.
capital_allocation.quote: You can consider around you may know between 4 to 5 years.

capital_allocation.claim: Interest applicable on the company's short-term borrowings is 8.5%.

risks_headwinds.claim: The US dollar exchange rate adds currency risk to the company's import costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to our import cost.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global factors have caused price fluctuations in raw materials.
risks_headwinds.quote: Global factors that are currently going on, based on that the price fluctuations that have come in raw material are coming, those are also coming upon global supply and the entire chain dynamics.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faces pricing pressure on product demand but passes the cost increases to customers.
risks_headwinds.quote: Importantly this pricing pressure also comes upon our demand of product, but since all people have been raising the price, so we have to also pass it through for the cost increase we also have to increasethe cost with the customers.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management has not observed any major operational challenges in operating the new manufacturing plant.
risks_headwinds.quote: No, not major. Because the plant has been installed in from their machinery and their technical know-how. So we don't find any operational challenges right now.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to reach full capacity utilization by the end of financial year '27.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to scale manufacturing utilization and increase manufacturing's contribution to 50% of the revenue mix in FY2027.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead to FY2027, our priorities remain clear: scaling manufacturing utilization, increasing the contribution of manufacturing towards 50% of our revenue mix, expanding binder sales into non-textile industries as well and deepening our engagement with global brands.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to reduce its debt completely.
management_commitments.quote: No, plan is to reduce 100%. So right now, the maximum requirement of our capex we have done, you know the manufacturing unit is already working. So now focus is on reducing debt also for our company.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.
management_commitments.quote: Additionally, we plan to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets increased sales volume through product portfolio expansion and participation in key industry exhibitions.
management_commitments.quote: Targeting increased sales volume through product portfolio expansion and participation in key industry exhibitions (GMMSA, Knit Show) and technical seminars.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated an expectation to selectively expand market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic wood coating segment.
management_commitments.quote: Encouraged by improving demand trends, we expect to selectively expand our market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic segment.

management_commitments.claim: Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to achieve full plant capacity utilization by the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects manufacturing to match trading sales at a 50-50 split within 1 to 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: Like 50% import and 50% products we may be manufacturing like that within 1 and 2 years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
